model_organism.citation: Peters et al. 2009 - Novel roles for erythroid Ankyrin-1 revealed through an ENU-induced null mouse mutant (PMID: 19179303)
model_organism.knockout_type: full knockout (ENU-induced null mutation; homozygous and heterozygous)
phenotypes: Profound anemia in utero
Severe hereditary spherocytosis in surviving pups, with marked hemolysis and jaundice
Compensatory extramedullary erythropoiesis
Tissue iron overload
Complete loss of ANK-1 protein and marked reduction of beta-spectrin in red cell membranes
Total disruption of red cell cytoskeletal architecture and severely altered hemorheologic properties
Heterozygotes have normal red cell survival and ultrastructure but profound resistance to malaria, not due to impaired parasite entry into RBC

model_organism.citation: A novel ENU-generated truncation mutation lacking the spectrin-binding and C-terminal regulatory domains of Ank1 models severe hemolytic hereditary spherocytosis (PMID: 21193012)
model_organism.knockout_type: other (ENU-induced truncating nonsense mutation Ank1 E924X; heterozygous and homozygous)
phenotypes: Heterozygotes show diagnostic hallmarks of mild hereditary spherocytosis
Surviving homozygotes phenocopy severe hemolytic hereditary spherocytosis
Homozygous RBC ghosts lack abundant full-length ankyrin-1
Truncated ankyrin-1 lacking the spectrin-binding and C-terminal regulatory domains

model_organism.citation: Normoblastosis, a murine model for ankyrin-deficient hemolytic anemia, is caused by a hypomorphic mutation in the erythroid ankyrin gene Ank1 (PMID: 14671619)
phenotypes: Ankyrin-deficient hemolytic anemia (hereditary spherocytosis model)
Truncated 157 kDa nb-ankyrin lacking the regulatory domain but retaining intact membrane- and spectrin-binding domains
Milder phenotype than the spectrin-deficient mouse anemias
Pathology reported in non-erythroid tissues

model_organism.citation: Calcium Homeostasis Is Modified in Skeletal Muscle Fibers of Small Ankyrin1 Knockout Mice (PMID: 31323924)
phenotypes: Strongly reduced sarcoplasmic reticulum (SR) volume around myofibrils
Reduced SR Ca2+ content at 4 and 10 months
Decreased amplitude of depolarization-induced Ca2+ transients, with unchanged voltage dependence
Lower frequency of Ca2+ sparks at 4 months
Smaller amplitude and spatial spread of Ca2+ sparks at 4 and 10 months
Impaired SR Ca2+ release
model_organism.significance: reported as significant (p-values not given in abstract)

model_organism.citation: Ankyrins are dispensable for mechanotransduction by cochlear hair cells (PMID: 40024092)
model_organism.knockout_type: conditional knockout (single Ank1 cKO and triple Ank1/2/3 cKO)
phenotypes: Ank1, Ank2 and Ank3 are expressed in cochlear hair cells
Cochlear hair cell mechanotransduction function is preserved
Ankyrins are unlikely to be components of the gating spring

model_organism.citation: Novel Identification of Ankyrin-R in Cardiac Fibroblasts and a Potential Role in Heart Failure (PMID: 39125973)
model_organism.knockout_type: conditional knockout (Ank1-ifKO, inducible deletion in activated fibroblasts)
phenotypes: Fibroblasts show reduced collagen compaction
Increased fibrosis in a heart failure model
T-wave inversion in a heart failure model
Preserved cardiac ejection fraction
Decreased collagen type I fibers

biological.citation: Distinct fetal Ank-1 and Ank-2 related proteins and mRNAs in normal and nb/nb mice (PMID: 8471772)
biological.summary: In nb/nb mice, which have a severe hemolytic anemia, Ank-1 expression is strongly reduced. Fetal reticulocytes express an ANK-1-related 165 kD protein and a 5.5 kb Ank-1-related transcript. Both persist or are upregulated in adult nb/nb reticulocytes, suggesting compensatory upregulation of fetal transcripts. A fetal-specific ANK-2-related 155 kD protein is also present.

biological.citation: Two novel ANK1 loss-of-function mutations in Chinese families with hereditary spherocytosis (PMID: 31016877)
biological.summary: Four ANK1 mutations (p.R281X, p.L97R, p.Y216X, p.E142X) were tested in vitro. They increased osmotic fragility, reduced ANK1 protein stability, and blocked localization to the plasma membrane. They also abolished interaction with SPTB and SLC4A1 (band 3).

biological.citation: Identification and functional analysis of novel SPTB and ANK1 mutations in hereditary spherocytosis patients (PMID: 39521890)
biological.summary: A novel ANK1 nonsense mutation (c.1994C>A) was studied in CD34+-derived in vitro erythroblast cultures. ANK1 mRNA was not reduced, unlike the SPTB mutations, and a truncated ANK1 protein is predicted. HS patients had elevated red blood cell-derived microparticles.

biological.citation: ASHG 2018 - Defective gene splicing with mutant alleles of the ankyrin 1 gene isolated from patients with hereditary spherocytosis
biological.summary: Novel intronic ANK1 variants from HS patients were tested in RHCglo minigene constructs transfected into NIH/3T3 cells. Many variants produced altered or heterogeneous splice products, consistent with computational predictions. This indicates defective ANK1 transcripts and altered protein. ANK1 tethers integral membrane proteins to the spectrin-actin cytoskeleton.

biological.citation: Zhang et al. - High frequency of de novo mutations in ankyrin gene (ANK1) in children with hereditary spherocytosis (PMID: 9470011)
biological.summary: In 40 children with spherocytosis, 33 had combined ankyrin and spectrin reduction. Of 19 informative heterozygotes, 12 showed cDNA from only one ANK1 allele. This indicates de novo loss of expression of one ANK1 allele as a frequent cause of HS.

biological.citation: ASHG 2022 - Analysis of MRI-derived spleen iron in the UK Biobank identifies genetic variation linked to iron homeostasis and hemolysis
biological.summary: GWAS of MRI-measured spleen iron identified regulatory variants at ANK1 and SPTA1. The common alleles increase ANK1 and SPTA1 expression, are associated with protective red blood cell parameters such as reticulocyte volume, and may act as modifiers of HS penetrance.

biological.citation: Identification of type 2 diabetes loci in 433,540 East Asian individuals (PMID: 32499647)
biological.summary: At a T2D locus, two overlapping signals have eQTLs affecting NKX6-3 and ANK1 in different tissues. This implicates ANK1 as a candidate effector gene for T2D.

biological.citation: ANK1 and EPB41 Variants and The Risk of Glucocorticoid-Induced Osteonecrosis (PMID: 41920036)
biological.summary: Rare heterozygous ANK1 and EPB41 variants were enriched in steroid-induced osteonecrosis of the femoral head (9/83 cases vs 0/91 controls in the discovery cohort). Patient erythrocytes carrying the variants showed reduced ANK1 expression, abnormal morphology, and increased hypotonic hemolysis.
biological.sample_size: 174 SLE patients in discovery; 246 non-SLE patients in validation

biological.citation: The SNP rs516946 Interacted in the Association of MetS with Dietary Iron among Chinese Males but Not Females (PMID: 35631165)
biological.summary: ANK1 SNP rs516946 interacted with dietary iron in association with metabolic syndrome in Chinese males but not females. The SNP also correlated with AST level, suggesting a link to liver function.

biological.citation: Sequence and haplotypes of ankyrin 1 gene (ANK1) and their association with carcass and meat quality traits in yak (PMID: 33655403)
biological.summary: Nine SNPs were found in yak ANK1, including three missense variants and promoter SNPs near Sp1 and GATA sites. ANK1 haplotypes were associated with hot carcass weight, drip loss, and shear force.
